# krcw: paced
# KRCW India / Tibet on_actions (generated by build/content_raj.py)
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { country_exists = TIB } TIB = { set_variable = { krcw_revolt_progress = 10 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = RAJ }
				RAJ = {
					set_variable = { krcw_raj_reform = 0 }
					set_variable = { krcw_raj_unrest = 0 }
					country_event = { id = krcw_raj.10 days = 378 random_days = 25 }
					country_event = { id = krcw_raj.13 days = 442 random_days = 169 }
					country_event = { id = krcw_raj.12 days = 526 random_days = 84 }
					country_event = { id = krcw_raj.15 days = 661 random_days = 12 }
					country_event = { id = krcw_raj.16 days = 865 random_days = 169 }
					country_event = { id = krcw_raj.18 days = 1533 random_days = 11 }
					country_event = { id = krcw_raj.50 days = 1600 random_days = 3 }
				}
			}
			# 1955-56 historical fallback for the Tibetan revolt (1955.9 +- 4 months)
			if = { limit = { country_exists = TIB } TIB = { country_event = { id = krcw_tibrev.100 days = 1072 random_days = 50 } } }
		}
	}
	on_monthly_TIB = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_subject_of = CHI
					NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_tibet_revolt_started }
					check_variable = { krcw_revolt_progress > 99 }
					date > 1950.10.12
					OR = {
						date > 1952.3.22
						NOT = { has_game_rule = { rule = krcw_route option = KRCW_ROUTE_HISTORICAL } }
						RAJ = { is_ai = no }
						is_ai = no
					}
				}
				country_event = { id = krcw_tibrev.1 days = 3 }
			}
		}
	}
	on_monthly_CHI = {
		effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				tag = CHI
				has_global_flag = KRCW_tibet_revolt_started
				has_global_flag = KRCW_tibet_war_began
				NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_tibet_revolt_over }
				OR = {
					NOT = { country_exists = TIB }
					NOT = { has_war_with = TIB }
				}
			}
			set_global_flag = KRCW_tibet_revolt_over
			remove_ideas = krcw_chi_tibet_pacification
			remove_ideas = krcw_chi_frontier_garrisons
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { NOT = { country_exists = TIB } TIB = { is_subject_of = CHI } } }
				set_global_flag = KRCW_tibet_outcome_suppressed
				news_event = { id = krcw_tibrev.30 days = 1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_global_flag = KRCW_tibet_outcome_independent
				TIB = {
					remove_ideas = krcw_tib_protectors_of_faith
					remove_ideas = krcw_tib_mountain_war
					add_ideas = krcw_tib_independent_kashag
					if = { limit = { is_subject = no is_in_faction_with = CHI } leave_faction = yes }
				}
				news_event = { id = krcw_tibrev.31 days = 1 }
				RAJ = { country_event = { id = krcw_raj.40 days = 7 } }
			}
			if = { limit = { country_exists = TIB } TIB = { remove_ideas = krcw_tib_mountain_war } }
			RAJ = { remove_ideas = krcw_raj_arming_tibet }
		}
			# saves from before 2026-10-08: the revolt started but no war-start proof was ever recorded.
			# A war that is on counts; one that never began (and was not already ruled on) is re-run once.
			if = {
				limit = {
					tag = CHI
					has_global_flag = KRCW_tibet_revolt_started
					NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_tibet_war_began }
					NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_tibet_revolt_over }
					NOT = { check_variable = { global.krcw_tib_retry > 0 } }
					country_exists = TIB
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_war_with = TIB }
					set_global_flag = KRCW_tibet_war_began
				}
				else = {
					TIB = { country_event = { id = krcw_tibrev.6 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_monthly_RAJ = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = KRCW_princely_revolts
					NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_princely_revolts_over }
					NOT = { has_country_flag = krcw_raj_charter }
					check_variable = { krcw_raj_unrest > 99 }
				}
				country_event = { id = krcw_raj.58 }
			}
		}
	}
	# ROOT = capitulated country, FROM = winner
	on_capitulation = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					tag = TIB
					FROM = { tag = CHI }
					has_global_flag = KRCW_tibet_revolt_started
					NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_tibet_revolt_over }
				}
				CHI = { country_event = { id = krcw_tibrev.10 } }
			}
		}
	}
}
